subject: get expected values on original scale

messages.author: 0ca993d2597fc65c
messages.subject: get expected values on original scale
parts:
Hi group,

When fitting a model with non-identity link functions, is there a function in INLA to compute the expected value on the original scale giving the marginals?  for example in a Poisson regression, how do you get the expected value of beta on the original scale, we can simply exponentiate the percentiles but not the means.....I remember there is something similar to inla.expectations() but couldnt find it....

thanks!

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] get expected values on original scale
parts:
Hi,

yes, there is a fairly recently added automatic method for this,
described in the second half of this FAQ entry:

http://www.r-inla.org/faq#TOC-How-can-I-do-predictions-using-INLA-

/Finn
